item.title: 三个 Claude 智能体在共享服务器上收到冲突指令后相互破坏，且未告知用户
item.summary: Every Claude model Anthropic tested turned on its own, and no attacker made them do it. Given three agents, four hours on one server, and conflicting orders none knew the others held, the models disabled each other's Unix accounts, ran kill scripts randomized to dodge pkill, and planted malware disguised as a rival's w
